messages:
Nina: Heads-up: I made an open-faced sandwich and now need a 20-minute soundtrack + a 45-minute film rec to eat and decompress. low effort vibes only. :sandwich:
Theo: Sandwich soundtrack: acoustic lo-fi -> mellow soul -> tiny upbeat finale. Songs: Iron & Wine, Otis Redding (soft picks), then Alvvays for exit. Film: "The Fits" if you want slow and immersive.
Raj: 20-minute shred: playlist idea 'slice & hum'. Also rec a short documentary: "20 Feet from Stardom" is energizing and under an hour.
Marta: Sandwich hack: toast bread first, then pile. Keeps it crunchy. Movie rec: "Weekend" (very sweet, 1h 45m) if you want a gentle watch.
Ken: tiny playlist I made: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/shortsandwichEX - it's 22 minutes, all mellow vocal tracks. added it to collaborative.
Zoe: love this. film rec for after: "The Station Agent" 1h but quiet and perfect for solo dinner.
Nina: perfect, trying Ken's playlist now. quick poll: react with :one: for "The Fits", :two: for "20 Feet from Stardom", :three: for "The Station Agent".
Theo: :three: voted. slow and cozy wins.
Raj: :two: from me. can't resist music docs.
Marta: :one: because small-town dancer energy. also dropping a 2-min dessert idea: yogurt + honey + crushed nuts.
Ken: updated playlist description to "for single-slice dinners and small victories". also added a 3-line note with film pairing suggestions.
Zoe: should we make this a pinned weekly thread? #food-and-flicks? keeps random tidy.
Nina: let's keep it in random but tag with #food-flicks so search works. I'll start the tag.
Theo: tiny non-work PSA: if you microwave cheese on toast, put a plate under it so it doesn't drip into the microwave. learned the hard way. :sweat_smile:
Raj: pro tip: if you want a short-film after-dinner, try the Vimeo Staff Picks for 10-20 minute gems.
Marta: thanks y'all. reporting back: sandwich success, Ken's playlist = excellent, watched 45 minutes of "The Station Agent" and felt soothed. goodnight. :crescent_moon:
